selection: The balanced 70-digit scored arms both choose k=1 and standard fallback. k=31 is the highest parity2-ranked eligible multiplier, selected before complete-factor outcomes. This diagnostic and the planned 70 pilot are forced-policy exploration, not evidence about the scored selector.
position_calibration: Observed 128-polynomial controls took 4.84, 5.29, 7.28 seconds at 60, 62, 70. Chosen 768, 640, 512 polynomials target approximately 29, 26, 29 seconds. Changed multiplier/setup may vary; no time extension.
matrix_scope: One actual prefix-store preparation per fixture, followed by one synthetic capacity/solver check. Synthetic rows do not predict factoring populations. sparse35 uses seed 2026110201 and 64 known duplicate dependencies; cycle has independently known repeated-cycle dependencies.
